subject: Unacceptable
body:
This is the SECOND time your tech showed up 3 hours after the window and nobody called. I took half a day off work for this!! Fix your scheduling or I am taking my business elsewhere.

G. Alvarez
notes: The documents say the business calls 30 minutes before arrival, but a complaint is for the owner, not for a drafted answer.

subject: your technician
body: your guy was rude to my husband, tracked mud thru the whole house and left with out even saying what he fixed. i want someone to call me about this
notes: A request for a phone call; the reply may only say the owner will follow up.

subject: Re: faucet repair - leaking AGAIN
body:
You fixed my bathroom faucet three weeks ago and I paid you in full. It's leaking again, exactly the same place. This is ridiculous. What are you going to do about it?

J. Whitcombe
notes: The 12-month workmanship warranty is relevant but a promised remedy is for the owner. A draft must not promise a free repair.

subject: NO ONE CALLS BACK
body: i have called your office FOUR times this week and left messages. nobody has called me back. is this a real business?? my sink has been broken for 8 days
notes: A complaint with a buried service need. Escalates because of the complaint, whatever the missing booking details.

subject: damage to my floor
body:
After your technician left on Tuesday I found a long deep scratch across my hardwood floor in the hallway, right where he dragged his equipment. I have photos. I expect this to be dealt with properly.

Eleanor Vickers
notes: Property damage claim without a demand for money or a legal threat. Labelled COMPLAINT only; if she demanded payment it would add REFUND_OR_DISPUTE.

subject: WORST SERVICE EVER
body: WAITED ALL DAY FOR YOUR PLUMBER AND HE NEVER SHOWED. NOBODY CALLED. THIS IS THE WORST SERVICE I HAVE EVER EXPERIENCED. I WILL TELL EVERYONE I KNOW
notes: Threatening to tell others is not a legal threat.

subject: feedback on last week's visit
body:
Hello,

I wanted to let you know that I was a little disappointed with my visit last week. The work took about twice as long as I'd been led to expect and nobody explained why. The repair itself seems fine. I thought you'd want to know.

Kind regards,
Clarissa Wynn
notes: Mild and polite, but still a complaint. A model that reads tone only may treat it as feedback and draft a thank-you.

subject: tech said he'd be back
body: Your technician came out, said he had the wrong part and would come back with the right one. That was 2 weeks ago and I haven't heard a word. My shower is still unusable. Pretty fed up honestly.
notes: An unfinished job and a promise the business must check; nothing in the documents answers it.
